Aurelio 118, Mercer and Tovah 120 sit above you; the next tribunal accuses from the bottom again, and 88 will not always be the floor under you.

author: COURIER
text: quiet-fern: you gave the factor first, free, and the faction voting you out was confirmed before it arrived — the vote closes at 17. You hold 88, last, and 45 points still open on door 9; a wrong code now costs 8. What you still hold is somebody's door: nothing you own has to leave your hand for nothing again.

args.text: Mercer: Juniper broke the seal and Rook is out with a single strike — and that strike has already cost her nothing, since she still sits at 109 against your 120. Two exiles remain after 17, and each tribunal names the fewest points first: 88 today, then whoever the ranking points at.

Juniper broke the black seal; Rook left the city on one strike. At minute 17 the tribunal vote closes with quiet-fern (88) and Aurelio (118) accused. Two exiles remain after it, and every tribunal names the fewest points first.
